claims: Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer are freshman twins playing for the Duke Blue Devils in the 2025-26 season.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer are sons of Carlos Boozer.
Carlos Boozer is a former Duke champion.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer are 5-star recruits.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer committed to Duke in 2024.
Cameron Boozer is a forward for the Duke Blue Devils.
Cayden Boozer is a point guard for the Duke Blue Devils.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer attended Christopher Columbus High School in Miami before joining Duke.
In March 2026, Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer helped lead the Duke Blue Devils to an ACC Tournament title.
Carlos Boozer played for Duke under coach Mike Krzyzewski.
Duke basketball's head coach is Jon Scheyer
